name: tinyrenderer-clang
summary: tinyrenderer spinning-head demo (clang-built C++ — ssloy's software rasterizer @9517998, T3 of the C++ port ladder)

tinyrenderer-demo.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Menu launcher: pass the packaged head model to the renderer (the binary's
# built-in default points at the overlay's /usr/share install, which a
# gucman-installed package doesn't have). Self-location is a known-prefix
# probe (todos/0444): /opt/<name> installed, /usr/opt/<name> baked; `[` is
# a hush builtin — zero spawns (the old dirname-of-realpath command
# substitution cost four processes per launch).
# Variable-free by design (#296): builtins and literal paths only.
[ -d /opt/tinyrenderer-clang ] && exec /opt/tinyrenderer-clang/tinyrenderer-clang /opt/tinyrenderer-clang/african_head.obj "$@"
exec /usr/opt/tinyrenderer-clang/tinyrenderer-clang /usr/opt/tinyrenderer-clang/african_head.obj "$@"
